faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Rain Children — our mission, programs and how you can get involved.
faq.q1: What is Rain Children and who does it help?
faq.a1: Rain Children is a non-profit association from Moldova, opened in 2020. We organise basketball, football and gymnastics training so that children with autism and Down syndrome can integrate into society.
faq.q2: How can I become a volunteer?
faq.a2: Simply visit our Contact page and fill in the volunteer form. No special skills are required — just a willingness to give your time and compassion. We will reach out to schedule an introductory meeting.
faq.q3: Are your programs free for families?
faq.a3: Yes. All of our training sessions are free of charge for families. We are supported by donations, so every contribution goes directly to the children.
faq.q4: How can I donate and will I receive a receipt?
faq.a4: You can donate through our Donate page using a bank transfer or online payment. After each donation you will receive an official receipt that can be used for tax purposes.
faq.q5: Can organisations or schools partner with Rain Children?
faq.a5: Yes! We do not have any partners yet and we are looking for them. If you represent a school, a company or an organisation, write to us through the Contact page.
faq.q6: Where do your activities take place?
faq.a6: Training takes place outdoors on two pitches: basketball at the “La Izvor” multi-purpose court and football at the FMF football pitch. In winter we train indoors once a week. In the future, with your help, we hope to train several times a week.
